deployment_recovery.issue: Backup memory pressure killed PostgreSQL before the first API switch; shutdown remained stuck after normal restart.
deployment_recovery.resolution: Added persistent 2 GiB swap on the existing encrypted disk, completed PostgreSQL recovery with SIGQUIT after SIGINT did not release the remaining process, then completed verified predeploy backups.

deployment_recovery.resolution: Explicitly select aws-lc-rs at startup, add a client-TLS configuration regression test, redeploy, and verify real Ting session delivery.
